searchText: yep agreed on the attesters. anyways I agree that there are arguments for why ePBS gives us this extra room, would be nice to put them more properly on paper to communicate numbers with a bit more confidence. happy to help, can start a doc next week I think my documents and diagrams have these numbers communicated correctly, without exaggerations and clearly This is the only non technical part of them yes i didn't mean otherwise, was thinking more of gas limit numbers specifically, how many multiples could ePBS enable, and what's the reasoning behind these numbers btw - consider also blob count to be part of the scaling, bandwidth will be more relaxed on more time, so peak bandwidth usage will be lower and will give leeway to a moderate increase in blob count yes totally, and was discussed as well by potuz and terence. here too could be an interesting exercise to just have a simple model for how to derive how much of an increase is possible
